line: A hundred years of summer temperatures, where the chart itself tells the story.
line_cn: 一百年的夏季气温，图表本身就是故事。

transitions: a hard cut is rare and meaningful.
labels: The subtitle is the figure caption: a text serif (Newsreader), ink colour, left-aligned with the chart, ≤ 2 lines, with a hairline rule above it and a small mono kicker for the range drawn so far. Words appear on their whisper timestamps over a paper-colour band. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
The title is the chart's own headline (Newsreader), set in world space above the plot; it fades when the camera is close and returns with the full view.
No captions over a signature chart operation or a silence.
motion: The rhythm of the data is the rhythm of the film. Map the marks to a musical grid; to accelerate, one option is to divide the beat instead of changing tempo. Pick a tempo whose finest subdivision lands on whole frames (at 24 fps a minute has 1440 frames; the count of finest notes per minute must divide it), so picture and sound never drift.

Pencil acting: lift before each tap, land with the shadow meeting the tip, a tiny rebound; hurry as data densifies, tremble like a seismograph needle at a peak. It can flinch (recoil and freeze), hesitate (hover before a mark) and exit (hand the story to the viewer).
Rescale reads as ratchet clicks (stepped, each step eased); a calm rescale is smooth.
Morph: a staggered sweep, each mark easing into its new form; notes fade as it passes and return as tiny marks.

native_moves.name: One mark = one fact
native_moves.fits: the first store a chain opened; the first patient of a trial; the first satellite launched.

native_moves.name: Axes grow with the story
native_moves.does: The y axis arrives when the narration first names the unit.
native_moves.fits: revenue; a city's population; vaccination rates.

native_moves.name: Pinned annotations
native_moves.does: Their content and colour carry the arc.
native_moves.fits: an athlete's season; a family's migrations; releases on a usage curve.

native_moves.name: Breaking the frame
native_moves.does: The chart must make room; the torn edge stays as a scar.
native_moves.fits: a viral spike; a price bubble; a record-breaking flood.

native_moves.name: Encoding morph
native_moves.does: Bars into a waffle, a map into a ranking, a line into a slope: the reveal of the whole.
native_moves.fits: a budget as units of people; countries as a ranking; daily steps as a year strip.

native_moves.name: Scale switch
native_moves.does: One value → the series → a longer real record, never extrapolated.
native_moves.fits: one day's energy use → a year; one species count → a region.

native_moves.name: The empty next cell
native_moves.does: A dashed slot for the value nobody knows yet.
native_moves.fits: next year's election; the next launch; tomorrow's reading.
